Build a reusable external reference PCA space

Source: R/08_external_reference.R
build_reference_pca.Rd

Fits a joint scaled-PCA representation using an external tumor population and an external cancer cell-line population. Shared genes are ranked by standard deviation across the combined log-expression matrix, and the top requested genes are retained. The selected genes, gene-wise scaling parameters, PCA loadings, retained PC number and PC-wise scaling parameters are stored so future query and candidate samples can be projected without refitting the reference transformation.

Usage

build_reference_pca(
  tumor_expr,
  cellline_expr,
  phenotype,
  sample_id_col = "sampleID",
  type_col = "type",
  lineage_col = "lineage",
  tumor_label = "tumor",
  cellline_label = "CL",
  input_scale = c("processed", "raw"),
  n_variable_genes = 10000,
  pca_variance_threshold = 0.9,
  scale_genes = TRUE
)

Arguments

tumor_expr

External reference tumor expression data, samples in rows.

cellline_expr

External reference cell-line expression data, samples in rows.

phenotype

Reference phenotype table containing sample type and lineage.

sample_id_col

Sample-ID column in expression data frames and phenotype.

type_col

Phenotype column distinguishing tumors from cell lines.

lineage_col

Phenotype column containing lineage annotations.

tumor_label

Value in `type_col` identifying tumors.

cellline_label

Value in `type_col` identifying cell lines.

input_scale

Either `"raw"` (TPM) or `"processed"` (log2(TPM + 1)).

n_variable_genes

Number of most variable genes used for PCA.

pca_variance_threshold

Cumulative variance threshold used to select the retained number of PCs.

scale_genes

Whether to center and scale genes before PCA.

Value

A `Tumor2LineReferencePCA` object containing the frozen PCA transformation, reference scores, reference metadata and cell-line scores.

Details

`input_scale = "raw"` means untransformed TPM; `input_scale = "processed"` means data already transformed as log2(TPM + 1). Raw RNA-seq counts are not accepted as TPM and must be normalized before using this function.
